description: A motor vehicle retail installment sale contract (simple finance charge), as used by dealers for indirect auto financing

form_number.description: The contract form number printed in the header, e.g. a dealer-forms catalogue number

dealer_number.description: The Dealer Number in the header

contract_number.description: The Contract Number in the header

ros_number.description: The R.O.S. Number in the header

stock_number.description: The Stock Number in the header; null if blank

name.description: The dealer's name, from the letterhead at top left (or the Seller-Creditor box if the letterhead is absent)

address.description: The dealer's address from the letterhead, as one line
The buyer's address, as one line

co_buyer_name.description: The co-buyer's name; null if the Co-Buyer box is blank

condition.description: New or Used, as written in the New/Used column

business_use.description: True if the 'business or commercial' primary-use box is checked; false if unchecked (personal, family or household use)

truth_in_lending.description: The Federal Truth-in-Lending Disclosures box on page 1

annual_percentage_rate.description: ANNUAL PERCENTAGE RATE, as a percent number (5.25 for 5.25%)

down_payment.description: The down payment printed inside the Total Sale Price column, in USD

payment_schedule.description: The rows of YOUR PAYMENT SCHEDULE WILL BE that are filled in. Skip rows marked N/A or left blank.

number_of_payments.description: Number of payments in this row; 1 for a 'One Payment of' or 'One final payment' row

amount_of_payment.description: Amount of each payment, in USD

when_due.description: When the payments are due, as printed (e.g. 'Monthly beginning 5/16/2020')

late_charge_days.description: Days after the due date before a late charge applies

late_charge_percent.description: Late charge as a percent of the late payment

itemization.description: ITEMIZATION OF THE AMOUNT FINANCED on page 2

cash_price_vehicle.description: Item 1A1: Cash Price Vehicle, in USD

cash_price_accessories.description: Item 1A2: Cash Price Accessories, in USD

document_processing_charge.description: Item 1B: Document Processing Charge, in USD

theft_deterrent_device.description: Item 1D1: first Theft Deterrent Device charge, in USD

debt_cancellation_agreement.description: Item 1K: Optional Debt Cancellation Agreement, in USD

total_cash_price.description: Line (1): Total Cash Price (A through N), in USD

total_official_fees.description: Line (2): Total Official Fees, in USD

insurance_premiums.description: Line (3): Amount Paid to Insurance Companies, in USD

state_emissions_fee.description: Line (4): State Emissions Certification or Exemption Fee, in USD

net_trade_in.description: Item 6C: Total Net Trade-In, in USD

cash_down_payment.description: Item 6G: Cash, Cash Equivalent, Check, Credit Card, or Debit Card, in USD

amount_financed.description: Line (7): Amount Financed (5 less 6), in USD

governing_law_state.description: The state whose law applies, from the APPLICABLE LAW clause
